title: Entangled Programmer
subtitle: LV, 500 FE a write
text:
Entangled devices that share a code are linked wherever they are. The Entangled Programmer writes codes onto Link Cards.

Put a card in the slot, type up to 6 digits or press Random, then press Write or Enter. Each write costs 500 FE; it holds 10k FE.

Right click a device with a written card to give it that code. Sneak right click to copy the device's code onto the card. Cards are not used up.

Public codes are shared by everyone. Private codes belong to the one who set them, so two players can both use 482913 without meeting. Use a screwdriver on a device to switch it; only its owner can change its code or open it.
